title: Veteran American Actress Jennifer Harmon Dies at 82, Broadway and Soap Opera Star Remembered
text:
NEW YORK, United States — May 14, 2026
Veteran Actress Jennifer Harmon Dies at 82 in New York
Veteran American actress Jennifer Harmon, widely recognized for her work in popular soap operas including One Life to Live and How to Survive a Marriage, has died at the age of 82.
According to family members, Harmon passed away on Saturday in New York City.
Harmon built a distinguished career that spanned nearly five decades across television and theater, earning admiration for both her on-screen performances and her long-standing contribution to Broadway.
Celebrated Career on Broadway and Television
Throughout her career, Harmon became a respected figure in the American entertainment industry, particularly in the world of stage theater. She performed on Broadway 21 times, a milestone that reflected her enduring presence and versatility as an actress.
Her performances helped establish her reputation as one of the notable faces of American theater during a transformative era for stage productions in New York.
In television, Harmon gained recognition among audiences for her appearances in daytime soap operas, where she became known for emotionally layered performances and memorable screen presence.
Tributes Expected From Entertainment Industry
Following news of her death, tributes are expected from members of the theater and television community who worked alongside Harmon during her lengthy career.
Fans and colleagues have remembered her as a dedicated performer whose work left a lasting mark on both Broadway and daytime television.
Details regarding memorial services or the cause of death have not yet been publicly disclosed by the family.
